claims.claim: Declares one Pi extension entrypoint in the package manifest.
Builds quiz context from current-branch user, assistant, custom, and bounded tool-result content.
Resolves project, user, then bundled quiz instructions in that precedence order.
Reads the current branch, builds a quiz request, and sends it through the selected model path.
Collects answers interactively and sends an explicit grading request before rendering results.
Offers one confirmed shutdown quiz and registers the manual /quizme command.
Keeps diagnostic logging disabled by default and writes cumulative JSON snapshots only when explicitly enabled.
The bundled quiz instruction requests five to twelve mixed-format questions and later grading explanations.
